summary: Frontend testing for 3 new features: Top pagination, Share button clipboard fallback, and Bookmarks page. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features tested and working: 1) Top pagination displays above and below poem list on homepage, 2) Share button on PoemCard works with clipboard fallback (shows green check icon and 'Link copied!' tooltip), 3) BookmarksPage at /bookmarks shows empty state, displays bookmarked poems, and clear all works. Sidebar shows 'View all bookmarks' link when bookmarks exist. Pagination state preserved through browser history when navigating back from poem detail.

top_pagination.details: Found 2 pagination elements on homepage (top + bottom). Page numbers clickable and URL updates correctly.

share_button_poemcard.details: Share button works with clipboard fallback. Green check icon appears after click. Tooltip shows 'Link copied!'.

bookmarks_page_empty_state.details: /bookmarks shows 'No bookmarks yet' message with bookmark icon when localStorage is empty.

bookmark_poem_flow.details: Clicking bookmark icon on PoemCard saves to localStorage (idunnopoetry_bookmarks). Bookmarked poem appears on /bookmarks page.

bookmarks_clear_all.details: 'Clear all' button visible when bookmarks exist. Clicking clears localStorage and shows empty state.

sidebar_view_all_bookmarks.details: Sidebar shows 'View all bookmarks' link when bookmarks exist. Link navigates to /bookmarks.

pagination_state_preservation.details: Navigate to /?page=3, click poem, click 'Back to all poems' - URL correctly returns to /?page=3 via browser history.
